Name: NPC Disguise
Author: dreamymc18
Description:
[size=5][b]NPC Disguise[/b][/size]
[i]Walk in the shoes of Pelican Town's residents—or any custom modded villager![/i]

[b]NPC Disguise[/b] allows you to seamlessly disguise your farmer sprite as any humanoid NPC in Stardew Valley. Whether you want to explore the valley as Abigail, Sebastian, Haley, Krobus, or a character added by custom NPC mods, this mod swaps your overworld sprite on the fly while preserving your real farmer in inventory menus.

Equipped with dynamic directional animations, responsive tool and combat lunges, eating reactions, and save persistence, it offers a polished, immersive disguise experience!

---

[size=4][b]Main Features[/b][/size]

• [b]Intuitive In-Game Menu (F8):[/b]
  Press [b]F8[/b] at any time during gameplay to bring up the "Choose Your Disguise" menu. Features instant search filtering, page navigation, NPC portrait previews, and a 1-click "Revert to Farmer" button.

• [b]Dynamic NPC Discovery (Vanilla & Modded):[/b]
  Discovers all eligible humanoid characters directly from game data outside the rendering hot path. Works automatically with newly installed custom modded NPCs without needing hardcoded patches!

• [b]Full 4-Directional Movement:[/b]
  Smooth, natural walk and run cycles across all four directions (North, South, East, West). Paced to match the farmer's full footstep cadence for fluid exploration.

• [b]Dynamic Weapon & Tool Swings:[/b]
  Swinging swords, clubs, daggers, axes, pickaxes, and hoes triggers a directional forward strike and physical lunge synced with the active tool overlay. Your character actively attacks and swings in whatever direction you face.

• [b]Eating & Drinking Animations:[/b]
  Consuming food or drink plays a visible chewing and bobbing motion in sync with the munching/gulping audio and crumb particles.

• [b]Safe UI & Smart Context Guards:[/b]
  The disguise applies strictly to active gameplay. Opening your inventory, skills, crafting, or character menus always displays your real farmer, keeping previews clean and vanilla-compatible.

• [b]Save & Day Persistence:[/b]
  Your active disguise is saved to your farmer's data and automatically restored when loading saves or sleeping overnight. If a custom NPC mod is ever uninstalled, the mod safely detects it and cleanly reverts to your vanilla farmer without crashing or producing invisible sprites.

• [b]Curated Villager Roster:[/b]
  Filters out non-humanoids, static counter characters (like Gunther, Marlon, Gil), animals, and festival-only sprites to ensure every available choice animates properly.

• [b]Console Command Shortcuts:[/b]
  Prefer console commands? Use SMAPI's console anytime:
  - `disguise_test <Name>` — Disguise as a specific NPC (e.g. `disguise_test Abigail`)
  - `disguise_test off` — Instantly revert to your vanilla farmer
  - `disguise_test status` — Check your active disguise status

---

[size=4][b]Installation Instructions[/b][/size]

1. Install the latest version of [b]SMAPI[/b] (4.0.0 or newer).
2. Download the [b]NPC Disguise[/b] mod archive from the Files tab.
3. Extract the `NPCDisguise` folder into your `Stardew Valley/Mods` directory.
4. Launch the game using SMAPI!

---

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

• [b]Stardew Valley[/b] 1.6 or higher
• [b]SMAPI[/b] 4.0.0 or higher
• [i]Compatible with single-player. Compatible with custom NPC mods out of the box![/i]

---

[size=4][b]How to Use[/b][/size]

1. Load your save file.
2. Press [b]F8[/b] on your keyboard (configurable in `config.json`).
3. Type an NPC's name in the search bar or flip through pages.
4. Click on an NPC to wear their disguise!
5. To take off the disguise, open the menu and click [b]Revert to Farmer[/b] (or run `disguise_test off` in SMAPI console).
